values./system/description: A cooking station provides an open flame and the tools used for cooking food and beverages. Crafting at it uses the Survival skill. It can be built without a workbench and functions for eight hours, after which repairing it requires 1 Common Material.
values./system/effect: Provides an open flame and tools for cooking food and beverages. It functions for eight hours before requiring 1 Common Material to repair.
